summary: Renders a UI field with text and an optional centered bitmap. Validates the label string at this+0xB0 (fallback byte_5EA438) and the visibility flag at this+0xC8, selects the rendering context via ShortComputation_6720 and ByteFieldGetterAt100, binds it through sub_498560, and measures the label with TextRenderToSurface. Computes a centered position from the bound fields this+0x4..this+0x10 and the optional sub-structures at this+0x98/this+0x9C (using their +0x4 and +0xC offsets), then renders with BitmapDraw_81f0 and writes the final rectangle to output parameters a2..a5. Returns 0 on success, -1 when no label/layout is available.

local_names.this: UI field object (vtable, bounds, label pointer, visibility flag, render base)

operations.description: Load the label pointer from this+0xB0, falling back to byte_5EA438 when null; return 0 early when the string is empty or when the visibility flag at this+0xC8 is clear.
ShortComputation_6720(this) selects the context branch; combined with ByteFieldGetterAt100(this) it picks the context string from the obj-relative slots +0x18/+0x1C, defaulting to byte_5EA438.
sub_498560(*(this+0x40), context) binds the selected context to the render base stored at this+0x40.
TextRenderToSurface(*(this+0x40), label, &v32, &v31, 1) measures the label into width v31 and height v32; if either dimension is non-positive return 0.
Vertical centering against the virtual bound query (vtable+24) and the sub-structure at this+0x9C (its +0xC and +0x4 fields); when the bounds do not fit, fall back to the raw vtable+24 result.
Horizontal centering against the virtual bound query (vtable+28) and the this+0x4/this+0x8 bounds; when the bounds do not fit, fall back to the raw vtable+28 result.
When this+0x9C is null, repeat the vertical centering using the alternate sub-structure at this+0x98 (its +0xC and +0x4 fields) and the vtable+24/+28 queries.
BitmapDraw_81f0(*(this+0x40), label, x, x + width, y, y + height, 1) renders the field bitmap at the centered rectangle.
Write the final rectangle into output parameters a2..a5 (left, right, top, bottom) from the centered positions and measured dimensions.
Return 0 on success; -1 when no label or layout is available.

clean_pseudocode: BitmapDraw_81f0(this[64], label, horizontal, horizontal + width, vertical, vertical + height, 1);
*a2 = horizontal; *a3 = horizontal + width; *a4 = vertical; *a5 = vertical + height;
